title: Feels good, not oily till the end of the day, not much Hyaluronic acid in this!
text:
Feels good, not oily till the end of the day, not much Hyaluronic acid in this!. I like that there is not any scent to Neutrogena face cleansing lotion.
I’m older but my skin is Not dry.. I do not use allot of makeup. I use this cleansing lotion in the shower everyday, and
Another face wash. I also use a wrinkle cream. My face feels supple using this Neutrogena, although later in the day it feels a bit greasy.

That said , there is 21 Ingredients in this and the 3rd from the last is Sodium Hydroxide, another name for Hyaluronic acid.
I’m disappointed, as this is advertised,Hyaluronic acid, also there is allot of colorings.
If your looking for a face wash that has some natural Ingredients in it, this is Not it.

3 stars.
